name: Data Science TRIZ
description: Same TRIZ machinery with data-science / ML / AI vocabulary — models, data, training, inference, accuracy trade-offs.

parameter_map.Loss of information: information lost in dimensionality reduction / quantization
parameter_map.Quantity of substance: dataset size / feature count / memory footprint

principle_soft.1: split one model into specialized sub-models (ensembles, mixture of experts)
principle_soft.2: take the bottleneck stage out of the main path (cache features, distill)
principle_soft.3: per-segment models; localized features instead of one global model
principle_soft.10: pre-compute features; pre-train embeddings before the hot path
principle_soft.13: invert the objective — predict the residual, treat anomaly as signal
principle_soft.15: adaptive / online learning; dynamic decision thresholds
principle_soft.24: embedding layer as intermediary; feature store as a buffer
principle_soft.35: change the model state — quantization, pruning, distillation

examples: The model must be more accurate, but adding features makes training too slow.
Inference must run on-device at 10 ms, but the full model needs a GPU.
